name: Hoplite

modes.label: Native service
modes.note: Hardware and complete resource tariff unverified.

plans.name: Pro monthly one seat
plans.note: Per seat. $82.50/seat/month on yearly billing (save 17%). Includes an unquantified 'Monthly usage allowance per seat'; beyond that, prepaid credits (1 credit = US$1). 14-day Pro trial for up to 3 seats for eligible Free workspaces. Plus is 'in development'. The legacy Scale plan is no longer sold.

caveats: Free 5 concurrent 2CPU/8GB sessions, 2 projects, card required but no charge. Pro $99/seat monthly or $82.50/seat with annual commitment, credits/limits not quantified. Enterprise annual custom. Free 2-CPU offer cannot satisfy 4-CPU workload; no public unit rate.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Hoplite is a coding-agent product: billing is prepaid credits (1 credit = US$1) drawn mainly by LLM tokens at per-model rates. Sandbox compute runs on Modal (default) or Daytona; per-sandbox provider charges appear only when the provider itemizes them, and no Hoplite CPU/RAM unit price is published. Keep the mode flagged alt and unpriced.
When subscription access expires, new cloud runs are blocked and active cloud runs are cancelled; a run on an empty prepaid balance stalls until credits are added (hard stop, no automatic overage).

fleet.verification: Card required at Free signup (prepaid cards not accepted); nothing charged
fleet.tiers: Free 5 concurrent cloud sessions; Pro and Enterprise higher usage but numeric concurrency not established.
fleet.notes: Free sessions are 2 CPU/8 GB. Marketing hundreds of sandboxes does not establish a guaranteed paid account quota. No exact self-serve path to 10/50/300/1,000 verified.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Modal snapshot-replace workspaces (the default for new workspaces) archive after the organization's idle policy and before the provider's maximum runtime, then transparently restore the worktree for the next thread operation.
snapshot_auto.note: Triggered by idle policy / provider max runtime; filesystem (worktree) only, processes and previews must restart. Also: 'While active work is running, Modal also keeps a baseline recovery snapshot and refreshes it periodically' and auto-restores it if the runtime dies; plus a durable workspace checkpoint is saved automatically on each agent reply ('Rewind points on replies', /docs/cli/acp).

snapshot_on_demand.quote: To restore saved workspace state through the API, [list checkpoints](/docs/api/listThreadCheckpoints) and explicitly [restore the selected checkpoint](/docs/api/restoreCheckpoint).
snapshot_on_demand.note: Checkpoints are created automatically per agent reply and can be listed/restored on demand (API, MCP, ACP 'Rewind to here'), but the OpenAPI spec has no create-checkpoint/snapshot endpoint and no fork/boot-new-workspace-from-checkpoint. No memory.

harness_api.quote: The public API gives your application repository-backed projects, persistent thread workspaces, agent execution, diffs, checkpoints, and PR operations.
harness_api.note: Drives Hoplite's own coding agent (models incl. Claude/GPT, BYOK, ChatGPT/Claude subscription routing): REST createThread (prompt), appendThreadMessage (follow-ups), listThreads/listThreadMessages, SSE /api/events/stream, stopRun/retryThread, tool-approval resolution; also MCP server (api.hoplite.sh/mcp), CLI and ACP. CLI handoff imports Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / Cursor session transcripts into a Hoplite thread; those harnesses themselves are not driven. The agent loop runs on Hoplite's side and executes tools in the sandbox.

ingress_rules.quote: Preview links require Hoplite sign-in and membership in the owning workspace.
ingress_rules.note: Ports are chosen in .hoplite/settings.json (ports.preview/additional); previews go through Hoplite's authenticated proxy on a separate origin; API integrations use a 5-minute gateway credential. Docker Compose published ports are forced to loopback.

guest_firewall.quote: Commands in a Docker Compose workspace run as an unprivileged user without `sudo`.
guest_firewall.note: Standard runtime is a Modal sandbox (gVisor) where toolchains are installed 'so no root access is needed'; Docker Compose VM runtime is explicitly non-root and Docker requests pass a policy proxy rejecting added capabilities/host network. No way to run nftables/iptables documented.

secret_proxy.quote: Eligible cloud runs can use the initiating member's connected Claude subscription. The connection stays outside the thread sandbox.
secret_proxy.note: Not a proxy for the sandbox's own outbound traffic. Model credentials (platform keys, BYOK, ChatGPT/Claude subscriptions, gateways) are used by Hoplite's agent loop OUTSIDE the sandbox, so they never enter it (arguably 'ai-only' in effect, set false for consistency with omnara). MCP secrets are KMS-encrypted and decrypted by the worker. Project secrets for arbitrary APIs are plain env vars injected into every sandbox command (readable by code), and a short-lived GitHub token is stored in private config inside the sandbox.
